## 目的 / Purpose

说明本次变更要检验或修正的问题。Describe the question this change tests or corrects.

## 证据 / Evidence

- [ ] 配置/manifest已冻结 / Configuration or manifest is frozen
- [ ] 原始日志或归档位置已提供 / Raw logs or controlled archive location is provided
- [ ] 分析可以从原始日志重建 / Analysis reconstructs results from raw evidence
- [ ] 正结果、负结果和失败均已报告 / Positive, negative, and failed outcomes are reported
- [ ] 首次介入前轨迹与系统负载已审计 / Pre-intervention trajectory and system load are audited
- [ ] 中英文主张边界已同步 / Chinese and English claim boundaries are synchronized

## 验证 / Validation

列出运行过的测试、分析命令和主要输出。List tests, analyses, and principal outputs.

## 主张边界 / Claim boundaries

说明该结果不能外推到哪些任务、种子、模型规模或硬件。State the tasks, seeds, model scales,
or hardware to which this result must not be extrapolated.
